tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Events in Miami and Miami Beach between two dates (Art Basel and Miami Art Week, the Boat Show, Ultra, the Miami Open, the F1 Grand Prix, conventions, holidays) and what a typical hotel costs on the nights we checked. Defaults to the next 7 days.

tools.name: event_details
tools.description: One Miami event by name (e.g. "Art Basel", "Boat Show", "Ultra", "Miami Open", "Formula 1"): dates, venue, attendance, what hotels cost those nights against a quiet night, points or cash, the closest hotels, and links.

tools.name: hotel_prices
tools.description: What a typical Miami Beach or Brickell hotel costs on a given night, against a quiet midweek night, how many were sold out, what is on, and whether it is a night for hotel points or cash. If the night was not sampled, returns the nearest checked nights.

tools.name: best_nights
tools.description: The cheapest checked nights for a Miami hotel in a date range, with what is on those nights. Defaults to the next four months.

tools.name: art_week
tools.description: Art Basel Miami Beach and the fairs around it in Miami Art Week: each fair's dates, venue and site, and what hotels cost each night of the week.

tools.name: nightlife
tools.description: Miami nightclubs, pool parties, show venues and arenas open now (LIV, E11EVEN, Club Space and more), where they are, their official sites, and the coming week's line-up from the club's own calendar where it publishes one.

tools.name: real_places
tools.description: The real places in and around Miami matched to the fictional Vice City in Grand Theft Auto VI's official trailers: what is there today, how to visit, how sure the match is (clearly shown, likely, a guess) and who made it. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

tools.name: things_to_do
tools.description: Things to do in and around Miami (the Everglades, Biscayne National Park, beaches, museums like Vizcaya and PAMM, Wynwood, Little Havana, the zoo, the Keys and free things), with prices from the official sites, how long to allow and how to get there.

tools.name: sky_now
tools.description: How many aircraft are over Miami right now, how many are private jets, and which airports they are arriving at or leaving (MIA, FLL, Opa-locka, Miami Executive, Fort Lauderdale Executive). Live from adsb.lol.
